notes.title: Update 0.834
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/efbcd1959504b84f5521e673dfdc6a9c24fa47d3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/2089ac070a6e650deb3714c9dead95ea27a67445.png[/img][/url]
1. Fixed errors in the textures of objects
2. The bug with the movement on the map section in the Garage location has been fixed.
3. Fixed a bug of reducing the force of the artillery shot
4. Changed the volume of some sounds
5. Fixed some errors in the text. Thank the players for the help!

notes.title: Update 0.832
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/efbcd1959504b84f5521e673dfdc6a9c24fa47d3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/2089ac070a6e650deb3714c9dead95ea27a67445.png[/img][/url]
1. After placing the first soldier on the battlefield, the time when opponents do not attack you is increased.
2. Fixed a bug with the location of scouts of the enemy, which made it impossible to pass through the cage where it is located.
3. Increased pause between dialogs, for ease of reading.
4. The sniper began to shoot even more accurately.

notes.title: Update 0.83
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/efbcd1959504b84f5521e673dfdc6a9c24fa47d3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32251208/2089ac070a6e650deb3714c9dead95ea27a67445.png[/img][/url]
1. Fixed bugs with movement on some maps
2. The complexity of the levels is increased. Starting with 4 missions, the headquarters of the enemy will periodically create new units officer, if he is not on the map
3. Parameters of healing by medic is changed. The Medic has become more effective.
4. Fixed the size of Chinese font display in dialogs
5. Fixed displaying of the name of buildings for all languages
6. Changed the volume of the final music after the battle
